text.p: Amtech Systems Inc said on Thursday that based on a preliminary review, it estimates income from continuing operations was $0.04 to $0.06 per share for the fiscal year ended September 30.
It estimated sales for the year were about $8.45 million, representing an increase of 23 percent from the previous year.

The sales rise, it said, "is due entirely to the expansion of the diffusion furnace business and the synergies resulting from the joint marketing of the company's IBAL automation and Tempress furnace product lines."

It said net income for fiscal 1996 is estimated at $0.09 to $0.11 per share, up from $0.06 in fiscal 1995. The 1996 figure includes a gain on the sale of discontinued operations, and income from discontinued operations for one quarter. The 1995 figure includes gains from four quarters of discontinued operations.
